title: ulmus japonica f. suberosa
intro:
Ulmus japonica f. suberosa, commonly known as Japanese Elm or Cork Elm, is a deciduous tree species. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus japonica f. suberosa include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which contribute to its health-promoting effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
